These make it not only easier to utilise such mechanisms, but allow it to be done consistently across platforms.

ros-humble-ecl-io.description: Most implementations (windows, posix, ...) have slightly different api for low level input-output functions. These are gathered here and re-represented with a cross platform set of functions.

ros-humble-ecl-geometry.description: Any tools relating to mathematical geometry. Primarily featuring polynomials and interpolations.
